title: Leadership and Verification Policy
description: How leadership requests are verified and what each leadership level may do in the portal.

sections.heading: 1. Leadership Requests
paragraphs: A member may declare a leadership position at registration or later from their profile. A declaration is a request for verification and grants no portal privilege until it is approved.

sections.heading: 2. Who Verifies Whom
bullets: National and regional leaders are verified by an MSAK administrator.
Institutional leaders are verified by an approved regional leader of the same association, or by an administrator.
paragraphs: The reviewer may confirm the position with appropriate contacts before deciding. Every decision is recorded with the reviewer and date.

sections.heading: 3. What Approved Leaders May Do
bullets: Post announcements to their audience (institution, association or nation), published immediately.
Add and update local churches on the church map within their scope.
Review church suggestions submitted by members.
Regional leaders: verify institutional leaders and view members in their association.

sections.heading: 4. Responsibilities
bullets: Publish accurate, relevant and respectful information.
Map churches only after confirming the location and contacts on the ground.
Notify an MSAK administrator when your leadership position ends or changes.

sections.heading: 5. Review of Roles
paragraphs: Administrators, and regional leaders for institutional roles in their association, may revoke a role that is no longer verified.
